changeSet.author: xiezm
changeSet.comment: Retire the warehouse-plan-owned modeling strategy entry. Platform warehouse planning now exposes only the global architecture dictionaries; the old deep link is handled by a frontend compatibility redirect.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE portal_menu SET deleted = TRUE, last_modified_by = '20260811-retire-legacy-modeling-strategy-menu', last_modified_date = now() WHERE deleted = FALSE AND ( name = 'sys.nav.portal.planningSystem' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata, '')::jsonb ->> 'key', '') = 'planning-system' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata, '')::jsonb ->> 'titleKey', '') = 'sys.nav.portal.planningSystem' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata, '')::jsonb ->> 'externalLink', '') = '/data-modeling/planning/system' );

rollback.sql: UPDATE portal_menu SET deleted = FALSE, last_modified_by = '20260811-retire-legacy-modeling-strategy-menu-rollback', last_modified_date = now() WHERE deleted = TRUE AND last_modified_by = '20260811-retire-legacy-modeling-strategy-menu';
